summary: Iteration 5 — Customer-facing B2B booking v1 (3-step self-register, T&A versioning, job_type + insurance, Stripe auth-hold + capture, hold release on cancel). Backend pytest 11/11 PASS. Frontend register flow + /book redirect + portal book wizard Step 1 verified via Playwright; Steps 2-6 testids + AuthorizationModal + portal-confirm verified in JSX source.

minor.issue: Response payload returns only {job_id, booking_reference, scheduled_start, zone, price} — missing job_type/insurance_approved_amount/stripe_auth_intent_id from the body. Frontend must do a follow-up GET /portal/jobs/{id} to read those. Not breaking, but useful to include for fewer round-trips.

action_items: OPTIONAL: enrich POST /api/portal/book response with job_type, insurance_approved_amount, stripe_auth_intent_id and stripe_auth_status (currently frontend must GET the job after booking to read these). Low priority — flow works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_book lines ~770-801: auth-hold is wrapped in a single try/except Exception — correctly never blocks booking. Good. Logs stripe_auth_error to job (truncated to 300 chars) — good observability.

server.py charge_job lines 2037-2057: captures `requires_capture` paymentintent via stripe.PaymentIntent.capture and sets used_capture=True. On capture failure, falls back to fresh PI — defensive and correct.

server.py portal_self_register: creates Shop + ShopUser + Stripe Customer + Checkout Setup Session atomically (best-effort). If Stripe is the placeholder _emergent key, returns stripe_checkout_url=null and stripe_unavailable=true — graceful.
PortalSelfRegister.jsx: terms scroll-gate verified live — signature input is HTMLDisabled before scrollBottom and enables after. Good UX.
PortalBook.jsx line 137 + 314: 'Card charge on completion' shows flatFee(calType), not approved_amount. Flat-fee invariant correctly enforced in UI as well as backend.
server.py is now 2410 lines — refactor to modular routers (portal, jobs, billing, public, owner) is overdue.
